## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: atomic whole-vector Account cap admission —
   the `reserve` op of the budget owner (decomposition row 28: Whole-
   vector reserve / physical-use fold, R5.12/R5.13 distinct operations of
   the same Account owner; PADR-R5-2 B.1 item 3). Reuse lower-layer
   codecs/stores; consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.6's
   `launch_bound` funding slice stands upstream (AC-1, AC-2).
2. Positive: projected reservation checks every ancestor hard key using
   owning primary/derived calculations — consumed usage, outstanding and
   new primary holds, slice holds — against projected derived totals.
   Exact boundary succeeds; refusing any dimension reserves nothing
   (AC-1; B.9 item 3).
3. Negative: individually-small input/cache or visible/reasoning
   components exceeding the derived total refuse; child/ancestor
   interactions, invalid/gauge keys and recovery races refuse; no
   charges to `tokens.*.total`; no parallel total fold (AC-2; B.9 item
   4; `tokens.*.total` stay derived — B.1 item 3 tail).
4. Ownership/evidence: REQ-D-006 + REQ-E-207 contributing-only mapped to
   numbered checks + actual evidence; achieved D/E separate from owed
   R/P/actual-execution E; full-target predicates remain owed to R5.19
   AC-3 (primary owner) — never claimed here (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: fails-without regression; `cargo fmt --all
   --check` + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode checks
   only if touched; counts recorded; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates as
   DEFERRALS rows with owner/trigger/control; ADRs for owned decisions;
   run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; O-01–O-08 + I-01–I-08 dispositions
   (AC-5).

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-budget/src/account.rs` — `Account::reserve`: replace the
   per-request-dim primary-key scan with the whole-vector admission —
   for every ancestor on `path(budget_id)`, every non-gauge hard key
   (primary *or* derived) is checked against the projected level
   `level(n, key) + quantity.key_total(key)`; first violation yields
   `InsufficientBudget{dimension: key, requested, available:
   (hard − level).max(0)}` (leaf→root, canonical `DimensionKey` order —
   deterministic); `>` preserves exact-boundary admission; gauge hard
   keys skipped per E5 (mirroring `BudgetTree::check`); gauge dims in the
   request still `DimensionNotBudgetable`; the refused row is ledgered
   (`reserved{outcome:"refused"}`) while nothing is held. Reuses the
   owning fold (`BudgetTree::level`, `ResourceVector::key_total`) — no
   parallel total computation.
2. `crates/hh-budget/tests/r5_12.rs` — the AC-1/AC-2 battery over scratch
   `Store::open_test` runs (the account.rs battery idiom: minimal
   `RunKind::Agent` manifest, writer lease, `Account::open`).
3. ADR-0391 — owned landing decisions (every-hard-key admission order,
   gauge-key skip mirroring `check`, untouched-key refusal iff already
   over, refusal payload/`requested` = request's key contribution);
   revisit triggers + adr-index regenerate.
4. Run ledger; PR `docs/build/pr/R5.12.md`; §6.5 close.
